notes.title: 1.0 Update is OUT NOW: new zone, new enemies, and Cthulhu itself!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/60a2943622722de56b98134757ac698bd040e889.gif[/img]

Hail to thee humans, 

All of you prove to be worthy challengers, and now the time has finally come: the Great-Old-One, the Only and Mighty, [b]Lord Cthulhu itself will face you in battle[/b]!  

It's been a long way, but [b]the 1.0 is finally here and will bring many exciting new enemies, a new zone, the Codex, and tons of quality-of-life improvements[/b]. But without further ado, let’s see the full patch notes: 

[list]
[*] Zone 7 + Cthulhu boss Fight.
[*] Updated visuals and structure of the Manor and the Mind Palace.
[*] UI visual overhaul.
[*] Killing foes now gives you small amounts of aether.
[*] Added a Codex with information about the various locations, creatures, and characters.
[*] Added subtitles to cutscenes.
[*] Added Damage/Effect Leveling Side Arms.
[*] Added prompts for weapon and transmutation unlocks.
[*] Various Balance tweaks.
[*] Added additional cosmetics and rebalanced cost.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=dTkh3zkc4JI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h2]SPECIAL OFFER:[/h2][/b] 
Madshot 1.0 is now available globally via Steam and Nintendo Switch as well with [b]a juicy limited-time discount[/b]! 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524550/Madshot/

We hope you can all enjoy this new update, and [b]we would like to thank you all for supporting us until this very moment[/b]. If you didn’t do it yet, this is the best time to join our Discord and share your feedback, experiences, and best moments! 

The abyss, and now the Great-Old-One itself, are waiting for you. 

See you there! 

Alessandro from HOOK 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access is about to END!
notes.content:
Hail humans, 

The Great-Old-Ones bring good news! 

We are excited to announce that Madshot is about to leave his early access stage. Save the date [i]*uprising fanfare intensifies*[/i]:  [b]the 1.0 update will be Live on July 18th[/b]!  

It’s been a long journey, and [b]so, so many updates were made so far[/b]: we add the Codex, the cosmetic system, the insight, tons of new enemies, sidearms, relics, and more but now we are almost ready to celebrate the upcoming new update and to share with you a sneak peek of what awaits you. 

[previewyoutube=Q9TRRPWav4g;full][/previewyoutube]

You all want it, you all hear about it, hell it’s even on the cover of the game: [b]CTHULHU AND AN ENTIRE NEW ZONE WILL CHALLENGE YOUR SANITY![/b] 

Along with our mighty one-and-only, [b]chunks of fixes, visual updates, and quality-of-life improvements[/b] will side along. Stay tuned for the full patch notes coming July 18th. 


The Abyss is waiting for you, now more then ever! 

- Alessandro from HOOK

notes.title: Devlog | New Update
notes.content:
Hey humans,

We’re excited to announce that a [b]new update[/b] will be available from the [b]6th of December[/b], and we wanted to give you a sneak peek at what awaits you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/301f76223d43f0f5cee96ce630dc6eae1d5ca400.png[/img]

Originally Madshot was supposed to take place exclusively within Cthulhu. There was no jumping or platforming, and you played as a naked prisoner… [i]Luckily ideas evolve[/i]. 

With patch 0.3 you get to experience [b]the zone we initially envisioned[/b], [i]if you can make it past the Coven Mother[/i]. We added a few [b]new tools[/b] to help you in this endeavor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/6c67502527cdd34cb092796932c6cdb5c17c9ce4.gif[/img]

Fight your way through the putrid fleshy hellscape of Chthulus’ innards, culminating in an encounter with the [b]Oculus[/b]. It's the first boss we designed, but remains arguably the most fun to play against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/0db93d79af60e478d46c0db6448d59693608cc42.gif[/img]

It’s not only the new zone that’s worth paying attention to. There’s been a complete [b]overhaul of the alterations[/b]. Numerous new ones, but we have also modified or rebalanced many of the old.

We focused heavily on deepening the synergies within the game. We also have more curated probabilities, to enable you to create more interesting builds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/726baa85bfe04aaa075d03b46ad6809abe4c85e3.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to show you more and hear your feedback, this is just around the corner.

See you in the abyss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update: Sidearms & Synergies
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/8219df1b5dff5802af8985bb2fd16abfccec9c59.png[/img]

Hi humans,

Our journey has just begun - and the abyss is deep - but [b]your support has been incredible and continues to be instrumental[/b]. Thanks to your suggestions and feedback we have decided to make the following improvements and changes to Madshot:

[h2]Sidearms & Synergies[/h2]

[b]Sidearms[/b]:
[list][*]Added a new sidearms room that spawns in the map.
[*]Added 8 sidearms with unique functionalities designed to augment your other abilities. [/list]
[b]Main Weapons[/b]:
[list][*]We have reworked the guns to increase variety and encourage experimentation with the new synergies.[/list]
[b]Input[/b]:
[list][*]”Drop action” is now "Pickup/Drop action" so you can still pick up objects when you have a sidearm equipped. Remember to use the custom key bindings to suit your playstyle.[/list]
[h2]Alterations: Paths & Synergies[/h2]

Alterations are no longer lumped into one pool. Your early choices will unlock new options that compliment your build. Experiment with different starting choices and don’t underestimate what a few “Enhancements” (level-ups) can do.

We have reworked most alterations to encourage creative builds and synergies, as well as added some new ones to make specialized builds more viable.

[b]Added[/b]: 
[list][*]Residue: Toxic foes spawn a gas Cloud on death.
[*]Recycle: Dominated foes spawn a healing orb on death
[*]Rust: First bullet after reload gains additional Toxic Damage
[*]Mender: Dominated foes are restored to full health.
[*]Pandemonium: Foes afflicted with dominate gain more damage for every other dominated foe.[/list]
[b]Remade[/b]:
[list][*]Most alterations have either had their functionality or numbers tweaked to better synergize with a wider array of builds and combinations.[/list]	
[b]Removed [/b](Or replaced with store items):
[list][*]Dark Coin
[*]Midas Touch
[*]Dark Touch
[*]Dark Coin
[*]Daze
[*]Flatulence[/list]
[h2]Others changes[/h2]

[b]Relics[/b]:
[list][*]”Face of the Abyss” duration has been doubled, and you emit a “curse wave” every 2 seconds.
[*]“Face of the void” now requires half the essence of the other ults.[/list]
[b]Visuals[/b]:
[list][*]Updated all the store Items' art.
[*]Updated some old Icons and VFX.[/list]
[b]Store[/b]:
[list][*]Various changes to store items functionality and price.[/list]
[b]Music[/b]:
[list][*]New alternating track for zone 1-2.[/list]
[b]**Warning**[/b]
Explosions now damage you as well. But don’t let that scare you off.

We hope you will enjoy these improvements! If you want to help us make Madshot even better, join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ta64VUv6gx]Discord[/url] to share your feedback and participate in our [b]exclusive beta testing sessions[/b].

The abyss and all of its crowded paths are waiting for you.

See you there!

- Camilla from HOOK 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png[/img]

Various fixes/refinements to gamepad functionality.

notes.title: Madshot is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/60a2943622722de56b98134757ac698bd040e889.gif[/img]

We are excited to announce that our fast-paced, acrobatic, rogue-lite shooter [b][i]Madshot[/i] is now available in Early Access[/b] on Steam!

[previewyoutube=3K_8JkH6g_g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ABOUT MADSHOT[/h2]

Searching for [b]eternal life[/b], you dabbled in the occult and summoned forces beyond your understanding, forces whose names should never be uttered -- and your actions ended with mighty [b]Cthulhu[/b] himself swallowing your city whole.

But this odd situation has given you the chance to [b]destroy him from within[/b]. Prepare to face off against [b]horrific monsters[/b] and survive [b]multi-phased boss battles[/b] on an ever-changing road to freeing your city from the mighty Cthulhu. Equip [b]endless upgrade combinations[/b] and use your acrobatic fighting skills to fight through a [b]procedurally generated world[/b] full of hideous opponents where every playthrough throws out new challenges in an ever-changing gameplay experience.

[h2]SPECIAL OFFER[/h2]

Madshot is available now via Steam Early Access for [b]$19.99/€19.99/£17.99[/b] but you can grab it now with a [b]20% OFF[/b] as a part of our [b]launch celebration[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524550/Madshot/

[h2]EARLY ACCESS[/h2]

[i][b]Madshot [/b][/i]is now in Early Access, so this means that the game [b]it's still in active development[/b].

Our goal is to create a game that will fulfill the expectations of roguelite action enthusiasts. We've put a lot of work into the key game mechanics, and we've also done our best to make Madshot hectically fun. [b]We aim to tighten the experience through cooperation with you, our growing community[/b]. Your feedback will help us identify areas of improvement and offer valuable ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/21640840a4cd5a9b9ee7315d742b1b188249d1db.gif[/img]

Now, it’s time to break the cycle of eternal life and share your experience and feedback with us on [url=https://twitter.com/MadshotTheGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/ta64VUv6gx]Discord[/url]!

See you in the abyss, humans.

Overflow & HOOK Crew

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hi players,

Between backflips and headshots, thanks to your feedback during the Steam Next Fest the team was able to spot some bugs and start working on improving the in-game experience.

We have decided to [b]keep the demo available[/b] on Steam, [b]updated [/b]with the following adjustments:

[list]
[*]i-frame rolls by default, can be slightly upgraded through the transmutation.
[*]Rebalanced the Chthonian: less health and shorter "wrap around breakout threshold".
[*]More healing from health potion rooms reward from 10 > 25 HP.
[*]More aether from rooms rewards 25 > 50, and from "The Grind" Alteration 2 > 10 (Demo unique alteration).
[*]Reduced "Shield zombie" spawn chance, and they no longer spawns in early rooms.[/list]

We hope this can be a good reason for you to jump back into Madshot and explore the abyss and all its crowded paths again.

See you there!

- Camilla from HOOK 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621323/db66d9db6dc5679927286a2a5a9ca358e438815f.png[/img]

[i]If you want to share your experience with us, you can send us your feedback and questions through our [url=https://twitter.com/MadshotTheGame]Twitter[/url] or joining our [url=https://discord.gg/ta64VUv6gx]Discord[/url].[/i]
